title: He Woke Up And His Sister Was STILL On Her Phone
caption:
He woke up... and she was STILL scrolling
Sunrise fills the room as he opens his eyes, then he sees his little sister still glued to her phone, dark circles and all, and he snaps.
Every sibling knows this standoff: the all-night scroller vs the one who just woke up.
Have you ever stayed up all night scrolling without noticing the time?
Follow to catch the next part of their story.
